verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs state it natively supports MCP from v0.6.31 and that users can call tools exposed by their MCP server from within Open WebUI. That covers both plugging in servers and using their tools, and a community user independently lists MCP integration among its key features. missing for 10: in-depth evidence on configuration, supported transports and authentication, plus hands-on corroboration of tool calls working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can now call tools exposed by your MCP server from Open WebUI.
Open WebUI natively supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) starting in v0.6.31.
